The European Commission has levied countervailing duties under Implementing Regulation (EU) 2024/2754 since October 30, 2024. They come on top of the EU’s regular 10% import duty and apply for five years. According to the Commission, Tesla pays 7.8% on cars from Shanghai, BYD 17.0%, Geely 18.8% and SAIC – MG’s parent – 35.3%.
